question: In March 2023, Rashmi Shukla was appointed as the Director General of which organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sashastra Seema Bal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rashmi Shukla** was appointed as the Director General of the **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)** in March 2023.
 
• The SSB is one of the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) of India, under the administrative control of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).
 
• The primary objective of the SSB is to safeguard the security of borders of India and promote a sense of security among the people living in border areas.
 
• Rashmi Shukla is a senior Indian Police Service (IPS) officer, known for her extensive experience and contributions to national security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sashastra Seema Bal** was originally set up in 1963, following the Sino-Indian War, and was initially known as the Special Service Bureau.
 
• The SSB operates under the motto of **"Service, Security, and Brotherhood."**
 
• It is responsible for the security of the borders with Nepal and Bhutan, and it also performs internal security duties when required.
 
• The SSB has been actively involved in various humanitarian and disaster relief operations across the country.
